en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a traditional restaurant or café. Tables are covered with white cloths, set with simple glassware and condiments. The walls are densely decorated with framed pictures, carved wooden objects, saws and farm tools arranged in patterns, clocks, jugs, plates and other rustic ornaments. A doorway in the center reveals a second room with more tables and wall decorations. The overall feel is of an early‑20th‑century Central European inn. Faint handwritten text appears at the top edge but is not fully legible.
